<root>.help:
Usage: root [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                                           
                                                                                                   
 AutoTester — AI automated end-to-end tester                                                       
                                                                                                   
┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --install-completion          Install completion for the current shell.                         │
│ --show-completion             Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or customize    │
│                               the installation.                                                 │
│ --help                        Show this message and exit.                                       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Commands ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ doctor          Check the repo against the design rules that keep it readable.                  │
│ providers       Show which model providers have credentials present on this machine.            │
│ map             Regenerate docs/MAP.md — directory map + schema summary, derived from code.     │
│ snapshot        Regenerate docs/SNAPSHOT.md — the digest injected at session start.             │
│ expand          Review/prune proposals, then generate only persisted human-approved cases.      │
│ login           Open a real browser for a human to log in by hand -- no password needed.        │
│                 Contract: qa/contracts/manual-login.md. The session is saved into the           │
│                 project's persistent profile; every later run reuses it.                        │
│ loop-status     Report gaps in `qa/.last-tick` — was the maker loop alive, and was any stop     │
│                 deliberate?                                                                     │
│ explore         Bounded BFS crawl of a project, refusing anything its write_policy              │
│                 denies. Contract: qa/contracts/explore.md. Nothing is typed except the          │
│                 optional login case; nothing destructive is clicked.                            │
│ approve         Grant a human's approval for one kind of run against one target (D-018).        │
│                 HMAC-signed with the repo-root approval key: protects against row tampering,    │
│                 not a party capable of rewriting the checker itself (AT-110).                   │
│ orchestrate     Run (or resume) the pipeline for `project`: the same entry-path choice          │
│                 (teach->INGEST / creds->DISCOVER) and per-stage `RunState` checkpoints          │
│                 `stages/orchestrate.py::run_or_resume` and its tests exercise, now reachable    │
│                 from the command line. Stops at the review gate (contract `orchestrator.md`).   │
│ release         Run (or resume) a release: every flow's validation plan, one issues log.        │
│ release-log     Print a finished release's single issues log and regression diff.               │
│ release-report  Write the damage-control report: regression, API failures, workflows, change    │
│                 history.                                                                        │
│ ledger          The feature ledger (docs/FEATURES.jsonl) — the only write path.                 │
│ flowspec        The FlowSpec review gate — nothing expands an unreviewed spec.                  │
│ report          Export a run as a portable tester report (Excel + HTML).                        │
│ ingest          Learn a product's screens and flows from a screen recording.                    │
│ issues          Issues derived from a recording — the tester's sheet.                           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

approve.help:
Usage: root approve [OPTIONS] {project}                                                           
                                                                                                   
 Grant a human's approval for one kind of run against one target (D-018). HMAC-signed with the     
 repo-root approval key: protects against row tampering, not a party capable of rewriting the      
 checker itself (AT-110).                                                                          
                                                                                                   
┌─ Arguments ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ *    project      <str>  [required]                                                             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ *  --kind               <str>                     read|crawl|adversarial|live_case|video_review │
│                                                   [required]                                    │
│ *  --target             <str>                     the exact base_url or endpoint [required]     │
│ *  --scope              <str>                     what this run may touch, in your words        │
│                                                   [required]                                    │
│ *  --granted-by         <str>                     [required]                                    │
│ *  --expires            <str>                     YYYY-MM-DD; consent is never open-ended       │
│                                                   [required]                                    │
│    --max-actions        <int range> [x>=1]        [default: 200]                                │
│    --max-probes         <int range> [x>=1]        [default: 200]                                │
│    --wall-clock         <float range> [x>=0.001]  seconds [default: 600.0]                      │
│    --production                                   required for an adversarial run against       │
│                                                   production                                    │
│    --help                                         Show this message and exit.                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

ingest.help:
Usage: root ingest [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                                    
                                                                                                   
 Learn a product's screens and flows from a screen recording.                                      
                                                                                                   
┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                                     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Commands ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ review       Review one recording: a flow summary and a short confirm-list citing exact         │
│              seconds.                                                                           │
│              Pointers raise attention; they never hide the rest. Exit 0 ok, 2 pointer errors, 3 │
│              approval                                                                           │
│              missing, 4 source unreadable; --output json writes one JSON document on every      │
│              exit.                                                                              │
│ register     Record a video as a Source. Idempotent on content — the same file twice            │
│              is one source, not two.                                                            │
│ list         Every source registered for this project.                                          │
│ prep         Probe, chunk and transcribe a recording. RUN THIS ON THE HOST — the                │
│              container has no ffmpeg and no GPU.                                                │
│ frames       Extract the stills the vision pass named. Needs an analysis on disk.               │
│ run          Watch one source and write the FlowSpec it produces.                               │
│ analyze      Run the ensemble over a prepared recording and adjudicate it.                      │
│ map          Fold every persisted video analysis into the project's product map.                │
│ zip          Register every video in a zip; exit 2 when any member failed (never 0 for          │
│              partial).                                                                          │
│ fetch-drive  Fetch a Google Drive video, folder or zip through the server's `gws` login.        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

ingest analyze.help:
Usage: root ingest analyze [OPTIONS] {project} {source_id}                                        
                                                                                                   
 Run the ensemble over a prepared recording and adjudicate it.                                     
                                                                                                   
 AT-220: `stages/analyze_video.py::analyze` shipped checker-PASSed with NO                         
 caller anywhere under `src/`. It could not be run, so the pipeline it sits in                     
 the middle of could not produce anything, and the scorer's advice named a                         
 command that did not exist.

│ *    project        <str>  project slug [required]                                              │

┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --models        <str>  comma-separated provider ids; two is the ensemble (default: the          │
│                        project's vision config, which may name several)                         │
│ --force                re-request cached observations                                           │
│ --help                 Show this message and exit.                                              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Usage: root ingest review [OPTIONS] {project} {source_id}                                         
                                                                                                   
 Review one recording: a flow summary and a short confirm-list citing exact seconds. Pointers      
 raise attention; they never hide the rest. Exit 0 ok, 2 pointer errors, 3 approval missing, 4     
 source unreadable; --output json writes one JSON document on every exit.

issues.help:
Usage: root issues [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                                    
                                                                                                   
 Issues derived from a recording — the tester's sheet.                                             
                                                                                                   
┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                                     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Commands ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐

│ list    Every issue derived for this project.                                                   │
│ pin     AT-597: pin a confirmed issue as a regression case (T-184/AT-585) — the                 │
│         CLI's entry point to `stages/issues.py::pin_issue_as_case`, alongside the               │
│         issues page's 'Pin as regression case' action. Steps are never guessed:                 │
│         pass exactly the reproduction steps you confirmed yourself. Runs the same               │
│         credential, reachable-navigate and one-pin-per-issue (AT-604) guards the                │
│         UI route does, so the CLI can never write what the UI would refuse.                     │
│ export  Write the issues as the 13-column workbook a tester can open beside theirs.             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

issues pin.help:
Usage: root issues pin [OPTIONS] {project} {issue_id}                                             
                                                                                                   
 AT-597: pin a confirmed issue as a regression case (T-184/AT-585) — the CLI's entry point to      
 `stages/issues.py::pin_issue_as_case`, alongside the issues page's 'Pin as regression case'       
 action. Steps are never guessed: pass exactly the reproduction steps you confirmed yourself. Runs 
 the same credential, reachable-navigate and one-pin-per-issue (AT-604) guards the UI route does,  
 so the CLI can never write what the UI would refuse.                                              
                                                                                                   
┌─ Arguments ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ *    project       <str>  project slug [required]                                               │
│ *    issue_id      <str>  issue id (see `issues list`) [required]                               │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --step        <str>  one confirmed repro step, 'action:target[:value[:expect]]'. A navigate     │
│                      target must be a full URL inside the project's allowed domains. Repeat in  │
│                      order -- e.g. --step navigate:https://app.example.com/signup --step        │
│                      click:#submit                                                              │
│ --help               Show this message and exit.                                                │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

loop-status.help:
Usage: root loop-status [OPTIONS]                                                                 
                                                                                                   
 Report gaps in `qa/.last-tick` — was the maker loop alive, and was any stop deliberate?           
                                                                                                   
 Read-only, and deliberately NOT part of `doctor`: doctor sits in the                              
 adapter's verify chain, so a stale loop would fail every unit's verification                      
 — a liveness signal that breaks the build is worse than the silence it                            
 replaces (AT-368).                                                                                
                                                                                                   
┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --strict                 exit 1 if the loop is asleep right now                                 │
│ --hours         <float>  a gap this long or longer is reported [default: 6.0]                   │
│ --help                   Show this message and exit.                                            │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

orchestrate.help:
Usage: root orchestrate [OPTIONS] {project}                                                       
                                                                                                   
 Run (or resume) the pipeline for `project`: the same entry-path choice (teach->INGEST /           
 creds->DISCOVER) and per-stage `RunState` checkpoints `stages/orchestrate.py::run_or_resume` and  
 its tests exercise, now reachable from the command line. Stops at the review gate (contract       
 `orchestrator.md`).                                                                               
                                                                                                   
┌─ Arguments ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ *    project      <str>  project slug [required]                                                │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --run-id             <str>    resume this run (pass the id a previous invocation printed);      │
│                               default mints a fresh one; an id with no state on disk starts     │
│                               fresh too                                                         │
│ --provider           <str>    ingest provider (learn path only) [default: gemini]               │
│ --max-screens        <int>    explore path only [default: 30]                                   │
│ --max-actions        <int>    explore path only [default: 200]                                  │
│ --wall-clock         <float>  seconds; explore path only [default: 600.0]                       │
│ --max-depth          <int>    explore path only [default: 6]                                    │
│ --login-case         <str>    explore path only                                                 │
│ --help                        Show this message and exit.                                       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
